title: Swarm Exposure
one_liner: Stack hundreds of simulated night-sky frames and watch satellite trails pile up into a glowing band.
headline: Press Expose to watch 578 simulated photos stack into a satellite-trail band over Mount Taranaki, then drag a slider to turn it into a glowing future halo.

episode.title: The Great Collision Between Politics and AI | #309

history.summary: A tight, self-contained canvas demo that nails the episode's image: frame-stacking animation, correctly sourced and clearly labelled "today" figures (578 frames, ~1,400 satellites, ~15,000 trail appearances), and an honestly-flagged illustrative slider that builds a convincing dusk halo. It resizes cleanly to mobile, handles reduced-motion, and the README documents a prior misattribution fix, showing real care about honesty. A few secondary-text sizes dip under the 15px guideline and the combined satellite readout could separate real from illustrative numbers more cleanly, but nothing here blocks publishing.
